Collect the arcade's earnings, attend to customers and keep the premises in order. Reinvest in equipment, additional floor space and useful help as those options become available. Review how the layout supports your current machines before expanding, and use the upgrade phase to prepare the business for its next earning period.

title: Idle Game Dev Simulator
description: Idle Game Dev Simulator puts you in charge of a game studio that starts in a garage. New releases combine a genre, theme and platform, while reviews and ratings provide feedback on what you create. Growing the studio brings hiring, research, improved offices and production upgrades into the same progression. Automation becomes part of developing the business, so the decisions expand from choosing a single game's concept to improving the studio that makes it.
instructions: Select the center of the room to open the action menu and begin a development project. Try different genre, theme and platform combinations, then examine the response to each release before planning another. Use the Research tab to unlock additional content and the panel on the right to buy efficiency or production upgrades. Expand the team and workspace as the available options grow, keeping the next release and the studio's longer-term development in view.

title: Idle Zoo Tycoon
description: Idle Zoo Tycoon starts with a small wildlife park and builds toward a larger collection of animals and exhibitions. New species attract more visitors, while improved enclosures and additional facilities support the park's growth. The game combines active tapping with automatic income, including earnings while you are away. That leaves you deciding how to use the next collection of coins: improve an existing habitat, introduce another animal or expand the space available for future exhibits.
instructions: Tap the zoo to generate income and accelerate your early progress. Spend the in-game money on animals, exhibitions and enclosure upgrades, then watch how the expanded collection supports further income. As the park grows, consider staff and other improvements alongside new species. Review the options you can currently afford before committing your coins, and use later earnings to develop the next part of the park. Continue expanding the zoo and improving the exhibits already open to visitors.

title: Idle Supermarket Tycoon
description: Idle Supermarket Tycoon places a shopping mall under your management. Growth comes from opening shops, furnishing them and improving the building, while serving visitors earns both money and reputation. Delivery vehicles add another source of income, and customer priorities give you another way to organize the mall. The business also needs attention between expansions: corridor facilities such as vending machines and trash cans can become clogged and require checking.
instructions: Use the left mouse button to operate the interface and the plus or minus keys to adjust the camera size. Open and improve shops, assign priority customers and distribute reputation points among visitors. Reinvest earnings in the mall or delivery vehicles according to the options available. Check the corridors as you expand, and consult the mission list when you need a concrete next objective. Completing missions provides rewards that can help finance another stage of development.

title: Ant Colony Idle
description: Ant Colony Idle turns a small underground nest into an incremental resource-management game. Food gathered through tapping and worker activity funds new ants, food slots and important chambers. Improvements to storage, the nursery and the queen's chamber give the colony more ways to grow. Achievements, cosmetic skins and a prestige system sit alongside that basic loop, letting you decide when to keep expanding the current nest and when to restart with lasting bonuses.
instructions: Click or tap the soil to discover food, then use upgrade cards to spend it on workers and nest improvements. Open the relevant tabs for upgrades, prestige, skins, achievements or settings. On desktop, scroll the menus with the mouse wheel or click and drag; on mobile, swipe through the sidebar. Check which chamber or worker improvement supports your next step, and read the prestige option before choosing a reset. Workers can continue gathering while you manage the colony.

title: Idle Train Empire Tycoon
description: Idle Train Empire Tycoon is a railway-station management game built around passengers, trains and the spaces connecting them. Buy and upgrade trains, configure their routes and open more platforms as the station develops. Waiting halls and other facilities are part of the business, while technology points let you improve both the station and its vehicles. New destinations broaden the decisions beyond a single departure, giving you more routes to consider as your train collection grows.
instructions: Use the left mouse button to interact with the interface and the plus or minus keys to adjust the camera size. Reinvest ticket income in trains, facilities or access to additional platforms. Review routes as new destinations open, and allocate technology points to the improvements you need next. Daily and regular tasks offer specific objectives and rewards. Use those objectives to guide expansion while continuing to improve the areas already serving visitors.

title: Idle Airport Tycoon
description: Idle Airport Tycoon begins with a modest airstrip and gives you an airport to develop over time. Planes, terminals and new sources of income form the main expansion choices. The appeal is in turning the available improvements into a larger travel hub, deciding which part of the airport to develop as the next options appear. It is a management game centered on building up the operation through repeated upgrades and additions.
instructions: Use the left mouse button to interact with the game's interface. The plus and minus keys change the camera size so you can inspect the airport at a more useful scale. Review the plane and terminal improvements currently offered, select an available upgrade and return to the overview to assess your next step. As new revenue opportunities unlock, compare them with improving the facilities you already have. Keep developing the airport through the options shown in its management interface.

title: Event Horizon: Black Hole Idle
description: Event Horizon: Black Hole Idle casts you as a growing black hole moving through successive cosmic scales. Absorbed matter supplies mass and energy, which can be spent on an evolution tree covering gravity, the accretion disk, satellites and jets. Larger celestial bodies appear on a timer and break into debris as you approach. A Big Bang reset exchanges the current run for permanent bonuses, while energy can continue accumulating during time away from the game.
instructions: Drag or swipe to move the black hole, or use WASD or the arrow keys on desktop. Approach matter to pull it in, and collect the fragments left when larger bodies break apart. Open Evolution to improve pull radius, income and movement speed. The round button fires jets, while scrolling or pinching changes the zoom. Before choosing Big Bang, compare the permanent benefit with continuing your current growth so the reset supports your next run.

title: Chicken Farm
description: Chicken Farm combines automatic egg production with a merge-based collection of chickens. Buy birds, place them on the farm and gather the eggs they lay to earn in-game money. Matching chickens can be merged into rarer, more valuable breeds, giving you a second way to develop production besides buying more birds. Coop improvements and farm expansion add further progression, and the chickens continue laying while you are offline.
instructions: On desktop, use WASD to move and the mouse to control the camera. Buy chickens through the game's interface and place them on the farm, then collect their eggs and exchange them for money. Reinvest the proceeds in more chickens or the upgrades currently available. Look for identical birds that can be merged and consider whether a better breed or additional production fits your next goal. Keep upgrading the farm as new features unlock, checking both the flock and the space supporting it.

title: Idle Hotel Empire Tycoon
description: Idle Hotel Empire Tycoon gives you a small hotel to expand through rooms, food service and leisure facilities. Open restaurants, cafes, halls or other available areas, improve the building and hire staff to look after rooms. Parking and presentation also form part of the hotel's development. Income from visitors can be reinvested in the operation, while active tapping offers a way to shorten service times when you want to take a more hands-on role.
instructions: Use the left mouse button to operate the management interface; the main screen provides access to the core mechanics. Open an available room or facility, improve existing areas and hire staff as the hotel grows. Tap the progress bars above reception and cashier desks to speed their service. Check the next available expansion alongside improvements to the facilities already running, then direct your in-game earnings toward the option that supports your current development goal.

title: Hazmob FPS: Online Shooter
description: Hazmob FPS: Online Shooter puts multiplayer firefights inside compact 3D maps, where movement and quick target acquisition matter. Its selection of modes includes Team Deathmatch, Search and Destroy, Capture the Flag, Domination, Free for All, Elimination and Gun Race. Choosing a mode changes the purpose of each encounter, so check the objective before treating every match as a straight score chase. The close-quarters layouts keep attention on the next engagement.
instructions: Move with WASD, jump with Space and run with Shift. Left click to shoot; use right click or V to aim. C crouches, G picks up a weapon, and keys 1–3 switch weapons. Keys 4–6 select skills, with E and Q assigned to alternative skills. Open P for the scoreboard, pause and settings. Practise moving and aiming together, then use the current mode's objective to decide where your next move should take you.

title: Sniper Attack2
description: Sniper Attack2 concentrates on precise shots across missions set in city streets, ports and desert environments. Each assignment asks you to find the enemy in the scene and line up a controlled shot. Its mouse-driven aiming links camera movement and weapon direction, making small corrections useful when a target is difficult to centre. The changing locations give each mission a different scene to read before firing.
instructions: Press and hold the left mouse button to begin aiming. While keeping it held, drag the mouse to move the camera and bring the enemy into your line of sight. Release the button to fire. Because releasing is the firing action, keep the button held while making your final adjustment. Start with a broad movement to locate the target, then reduce the size of your movements as the aim settles. Recheck the scene after a shot and continue with the mission's remaining enemies.

title: Road Chase: Shooter Realistic Guns
description: Road Chase: Shooter Realistic Guns makes escaping a pursuit a shooting challenge. Your car faces attackers arriving in motorcycles, off-road vehicles, drones and helicopters, and each level ends when the pursuers have been destroyed. A growing arsenal includes firearms and a crossbow, with further weapons and locations unlocked through progress. Different vehicles and bosses give you reasons to reconsider your weapon choice as the chase continues.
instructions: Move the mouse to aim and press the left button to shoot. Switch between available weapons with keys 1–4 and reload with R. On mobile, use the touchscreen shooting controls. Look at the approaching vehicle before firing: the game lets you target wheels, vehicle parts and mounted weapons as well as the attackers themselves. Keep track of your ammunition and switch weapons when another option better suits the target. Clear the full pursuit to finish the level and continue unlocking the campaign's locations.

title: Bomb the Castle
description: Bomb the Castle stages artillery duels between moving, destructible fortresses. Break through the opposing structure to reach its crew, or bring down the castle itself to win. Arena features such as swinging gates, power strips and floating bonus crates affect how you position and aim. Between battles, train crew members, strengthen walls and wheels, and expand your own castle as you progress through a league of computer-controlled rivals.
instructions: Drag backwards on the battlefield with a mouse or finger, then release to fire. Return to the drag's starting point to cancel, and select a crew card to change weapons. With a keyboard, A/D or the horizontal arrows move the castle, W/S or the vertical arrows adjust aim, and Q/E changes power. Space or Enter fires. Watch moving obstacles before releasing a shot, and use the damage from each hit to plan the next angle. Crew training and structural upgrades are available between duels.

title: Iron Defense
description: Iron Defense places a turret on a scrap wall while waves of junk robots approach from the right. You control the firing and add fire, ice or lightning abilities to protect the position. Salvaged gold and crystals improve the turret, wall, electrified floor and supporting gun pylons between stages. The campaign leads through escalating waves and bosses, with Endless mode available after its final stage.
instructions: Hold the mouse button or a finger on the battlefield to fire at incoming robots. To use an ability, drag its button onto the field and release; releasing over a button cancels the cast. Abilities consume energy that replenishes over time, so decide when a wave needs extra help. The plus button spends crystals to refill energy. Defeat every wave before the wall collapses, then visit UPGRADES to strengthen the parts of the defense that struggled. Clearing stage 100 opens the Endless challenge.

title: Deorbit - Space Survivors
description: Deorbit - Space Survivors combines spaceship movement with automatically firing weapons. Your attention goes to navigating enemy swarms, collecting experience and shaping a new build during each run. Level-up choices, drones and passive upgrades change what your ship can handle, while minibosses lead towards a sector boss. Gold carried out of a run funds permanent improvements, giving future attempts a stronger starting point.
instructions: Move with WASD, the arrow keys or the touch joystick. Nearby enemies are attacked automatically, so steer around incoming threats while collecting the experience orbs they drop. Use Dash to escape a dangerous position, and choose one of three upgrade cards when you level up. Chests require Iridium and provide additional items. Survive the waves and defeat the sector boss to open the next area. Between runs, spend retained gold on permanent upgrades and compare your available ships before choosing the next attempt.

title: Dogfight
description: Dogfight puts you in control of a combat aircraft that can turn, loop and roll through aerial engagements. Managing speed and attitude is part of lining up a shot, rather than simply following a target with a stationary sight. A primary gun and a secondary weapon provide different attack options. The control layout supports both keyboard flight and a mobile joystick with separate action buttons.
instructions: On desktop, W increases speed and S slows the aircraft. A/D turns left or right, while Q/E makes sharper turns. Press Space to pull up and Shift to roll. J fires the main weapon, K uses the sub-weapon, and R reloads. On mobile, steer with the on-screen joystick and use the fire, pitch and roll buttons. Learn the difference between an ordinary turn and a sharp turn before combining several maneuvers. Adjust the aircraft's position, line up the target, and leave room to change direction after firing.

title: Archer Ragdoll
description: Archer Ragdoll builds bow combat around flexible characters, bouncing arrows and protective armor. A shot's impact can change with where it lands, so watching the result is part of preparing the next attempt. Different arrow types and character upgrades provide further options as opponents and bosses become more demanding. The ragdoll reactions make each exchange a physical interaction between the archer, projectile and target.
instructions: Use the mouse or touch the highlighted area on the left side of the screen. Hold behind the archer's back to draw the bow; a separate horizontal pulling motion is not required. Keep holding while you adjust the aim, then release to send the arrow. Watch whether it hits, rebounds or catches armor before choosing the next line. Small changes to the aim can help you compare results without changing everything at once. Experiment with the available arrows and use hero upgrades as you progress through the encounters.

title: Naval Base
description: Naval Base mixes a coastal gun with a fleet that fights automatically once deployed. Your objective is to destroy the opposing base before the operation's timer expires. Ships, aircraft and submarines form a counter system, making the composition of both fleets important. Defenses can be upgraded, and different operations introduce different bosses, so choosing units is as central as directing the coastal weapon.
instructions: Buy units from the bottom bar and let them enter combat. Ships counter aircraft, aircraft hunt submarines, and submarines threaten ships; look at the enemy formation before spending on the next unit. On desktop, A/D or the screen edges move the camera, W/S or Up/Down adjusts the coastal gun's aim, and number keys purchase units. Touch players drag the battle view and use the displayed controls. Keep the timer in view and balance reinforcing your fleet with pressure on the enemy base.

title: Flip Gun 3D Ragdoll Shooter
description: Flip Gun 3D Ragdoll Shooter turns the gun's own movement into part of aiming. Each tap fires and flips the weapon, while ragdoll targets react to successful hits. Obstacles and target arrangements create different challenges, and additional weapons give you other combinations of flipping and shooting behavior to explore. Completing a level requires knocking down every target within the available shot allowance.
instructions: Tap to shoot, then watch the gun's rotation before choosing the next moment to fire. Aim to connect with the ragdoll targets and use shots that break obstructing objects when needed. Since shots are limited, inspect what is still standing before committing to another tap. Learn how the current weapon moves between shots, then try a different unlocked weapon to compare its behavior. Focus first on landing a controlled hit, and use the resulting target movement to plan how you will clear the rest of the level.

title: Bridge Builder
description: Bridge Builder puts the strength of your designs on trial. Each puzzle asks you to assemble a bridge that can support a vehicle, choosing from different construction materials and adapting the structure to the crossing. The levels span four locations, so a successful idea still needs to suit the next task. Physics determines whether your design holds up when the simulation starts. This gives every adjustment a clear purpose: build a usable crossing, test the result, and rethink the sections that cannot carry the load. A built-in hint system offers help when a structure leaves you stuck.
instructions: On a computer, drag with the left mouse button to build and press Space to start the simulation. Use Z to undo a change, or double-click a bridge part with the left button to remove it. On mobile, use the touchscreen and the on-screen controls. Test your construction after making changes and use the hints when you need another way into a puzzle.

title: Pocket Mart
description: Pocket Mart starts with a tomato shelf and a small corner shop, then lets you grow into a three-room market with ten products. Carry supplies from the warehouse, refill shelves, serve customers at the register, and put earnings toward more stock, upgrades, and employees. Cashiers, stockers, and cleaners can help with the workload as the shop expands. Restocking also takes you beyond the counter: order by phone or drive to the farm market and mall for cheaper boxes. Customers react to empty shelves and slow queues, making the balance between supply and service part of running the business.
instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys, or drag on a phone. Stand in marked circles to collect goods, stock shelves, operate the register, and pick up cash. Use the buttons at pads and desks to purchase improvements. Tap Order for supplies, or press Drive at your car and unload purchases in the delivery bay.

title: City Bus Simulator Driving Games
description: City Bus Simulator Driving Games combines passenger routes with the challenge of handling and parking a large vehicle. Pick people up around the city, follow the map to their destinations, and complete driving missions as the levels become harder. City Mode focuses on passenger transport through busy streets. Winter Mode moves the driving challenge onto snowy, slippery roads, where careful control matters. Free Mode gives you room to explore without mission restrictions. Different buses can be unlocked along the way, while routes and parking areas provide separate reasons to think about how you approach each destination.
instructions: On desktop, use W, A, S, and D to move the bus and Space to brake. Press C to change the camera angle, P to pause, or Ctrl to open settings. On mobile, steer with the left and right buttons and use the acceleration and brake controls. Consult the in-game map for routes, then position the bus carefully for passenger stops and parking tasks.

title: Field Master
description: Field Master follows the work of a farm through its growing cycle, with you operating the machines needed at each stage. Start by preparing fields with a tractor, move on to sowing seeds with seeders, and nurture the crops as they grow. Harvesting then puts you in control of combines to gather the crop. The focus is on moving through these agricultural jobs yourself, from working the soil to bringing in the harvest. Switching between machines makes the equipment part of the process, giving the farming cycle a practical sequence to follow as you work across the fields.
instructions: On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys to move: W or Up goes upward, S or Down downward, and A or D moves left or right. Press Q to switch vehicles and E to load or unload. Mobile players use the directional buttons. Match your machine to the current farming task and work through soil preparation, sowing, crop care, and harvesting.

title: Flufflings: Pocket Pets
description: Flufflings: Pocket Pets turns a home and yard into a welcoming place for stray kittens. Food attracts visitors, while extra toys and decorations help make the space appealing. Looking after the cats also supports your progress: happier visitors leave more coins when they depart. You can use those rewards to keep improving the space and bringing in more fluffy guests. A favorite visitor can become a permanent companion when you give it a collar. Alongside decorating, the game gives you small care activities such as filling bowls, playing with a ball, and checking a cat’s characteristics.
instructions: Leave food outside to attract cats. Drop food or water into a bowl to fill it, and drag and release the ball to play with your visitors. Hold a cat to view its information. Put a collar on a kitten you want to adopt so it stays permanently. Click the gate when you want to stop new cats from entering the yard.

title: Airplane Flight Manager Game
description: Airplane Flight Manager Game puts you in the pilot’s seat for journeys between airports. Take off, guide the aircraft through the sky, and work toward a safe landing at the destination. Missions give each flight a place to reach, while the open setting and clouds provide the surroundings for the trip. Its central activity is controlling an airplane through the journey from departure to arrival. That makes the destination a useful reference as you explore the skies and work through your flight missions. The game presents this flying experience with simple directional controls and a three-dimensional environment.
instructions: Use W or the Up arrow to move forward and S or the Down arrow to move backward. A or the Left arrow moves left; D or the Right arrow moves right. Use the mouse to click buttons. Follow the current mission’s destination, guide the airplane from its starting airport, and bring the flight to a safe landing at the next one.

title: Dream Home
description: Dream Home lets you build a house from the ground up and then walk through the result. Raise walls and floors, choose paint or wallpaper, lay flooring, and furnish the rooms. The yard is another space to design, with decorations ranging from flower beds to a pool or fountain. First-person walk mode lets you inspect the house, climb its stairs, and see it by day or night. Client orders add a brief to build around: completed work is graded and earns experience toward new levels and plots. There is also a daily challenge order for another building task.
instructions: On a computer, use the mouse to build, right-click to rotate the camera, and scroll to zoom. WASD or the arrow keys move the camera; R rotates an item and Delete sells it. Press Esc to leave walk mode. On a phone, tap to build or select, use two fingers to rotate and zoom, and use the joystick when walking.

title: Burger Restaurant Simulator 3D
description: Burger Restaurant Simulator 3D combines cooking with the decisions needed to expand a food business. Take orders and prepare burgers, fries, nuggets, drinks, and coffee, then develop the menu with more dishes. Earnings can go into better kitchen equipment, employees, or an interior that gives the restaurant its own look. Staff can be trained as the operation grows, and satisfied customers contribute tips and reputation. Expansion reaches beyond the original restaurant through new branches, a cafe, or a food truck. The daily work moves between serving customers and deciding which part of the business to improve next.
instructions: Use WASD to move and the mouse to turn the camera. Press E to interact, M to open the shop, and Tab to show or hide the cursor. J opens daily tasks, H opens the daily reward, and P pauses the game. Take customer orders, cook the requested food, and use your profits to improve the kitchen and hire or train staff.

title: Launch the Dummy!
description: Launch the Dummy! is a physics playground built around one spectacular trip down a hill. Push a crash test dummy into motion, launch from the ramp, and send it bouncing through bowling pins, dominoes, crates, and balloons. Both distance and damage earn cash, turning each attempt into a chance to improve the next launch. Upgrades cover the hill, ride, rockets, eject spring, and wingsuit, with rides ranging from a shopping cart to a rocket sled. Boost rings and object-smashing combos add things to aim for during the flight. The larger target is the lake at 1,500 metres.
instructions: Tap or click to push off and jump in. Tap or click again at the ramp to launch the dummy. Hold the screen or mouse button to glide with the wingsuit. Pass through boost rings and hit objects to chain combos, then spend the cash from distance and damage on upgrades that help you work toward the lake.

title: Fun fishing
description: Fun fishing builds its progression around catching fish, selling the haul, and improving your equipment. The fish range from common catches to rarer finds, giving you different things to look for as you explore. Money from sales goes toward better fishing rods and other gear, while boats and additional areas provide more places to visit. The loop connects each fishing trip to the next: bring in a catch, turn it into money, and decide how to develop your equipment before heading out again. Its focus on fishing, movement, and exploration makes the locations part of the activity alongside the catch itself.
instructions: On a computer, move with WASD and press Space to jump. Use the left mouse button to interact, or E to interact with objects. On mobile, the joystick on the left side of the screen moves your character, while the right side turns the camera. Catch and sell fish, then put your earnings toward gear upgrades and exploring further locations.

title: Stickman Kombat 2D
description: Stickman Kombat 2D turns a simple stick figure into a fighter with regular attacks, specials, blocks and aerial strikes. Its battles reward learning how those moves connect: a timed follow-up can extend a combo, while stamina limits how freely you keep attacking. Earn coins from victories to unlock additional fighters, or share the controls with a second player for local matches. Breaking out of an opponent's combination and finding a safe opening are both part of the fight.
instructions: In solo play, use WASD to move, J for an attack and K for a special. Press S and J together for an uppercut, hold S to block, or combine a backward direction with K for another special. Try jumping behind your opponent before striking. Watch stamina and practice a short combo before adding more hits. Local two-player mode uses separate keyboard layouts, so check each player's controls before starting.

title: Epic Sword Battle! Fight in the Ragdoll Arena!
description: Epic Sword Battle: Fight in the Ragdoll Arena puts sword-wielding fighters into physical duels where movement shapes each attack. Knights and gladiators face different opponents across a succession of arenas, and the ragdoll reactions give exchanges an unpredictable appearance. The objective stays direct: win the duel while dealing with the other fighter's swings. Progress brings more battles and swords to try, with a leaderboard providing a way to compare results beyond an individual encounter.
instructions: On a computer, hold the left mouse button and move the pointer to guide your fighter and swing the weapon. On a phone or tablet, slide a finger across the screen to move and strike. Start with controlled movements to see how the sword follows your input. Keep watching the opponent's position as you attack, and adjust your motion when their weapon comes toward you. Winning the current duel is the route to the next opponent.

title: Dogs vs Aliens
description: Dogs vs Aliens follows a rescue campaign after extraterrestrial invaders kidnap the pets. Lead a growing group of dogs through locations such as a beach, park, city square and forest, gathering resources and freeing the animals along the way. New breeds, upgrades and evolutions develop your canine team as quests lead to further territories and boss encounters. Combat happens automatically at close range, so moving your dogs into position is central to the action.
instructions: Use WASD or the mouse to move on desktop; on a touchscreen, guide the dogs with a finger. Approach an enemy to start attacking, then bring defeated enemies back to the base as instructed. Collect the resources needed for upgrades and continue the rescue objectives to open more of the map. Since attacks trigger near opponents, pay attention to where you are leading the group. Follow the quests toward the remaining captive pets and the alien bosses.

title: Draw Action
description: Draw Action makes the path of your gesture part of the fighting system. Instead of choosing from a row of fixed attack buttons, you draw a movement for the blue fighter's arm or leg and watch the resulting strike. The goal is to defeat every opponent, either by exhausting their health or by sending them off the platform into the water. Later encounters introduce more demanding opposition, while stat upgrades and different attack patterns give you ways to change your approach.
instructions: Tap an arm or leg on the blue character, then draw the pattern you want that limb to follow. Try different shapes to learn which movements produce useful strikes against the enemy in front of you. Watch both the opponent's health and their distance from the edge. A knockback can finish a fight even when health remains. Upgrade your fighter's stats as you progress and build combinations that suit the next group of enemies.

title: Ragdoll Battle Royale! Throw Down the Enemy!
description: Ragdoll Battle Royale: Throw Down the Enemy is a compact arena contest built around pushing opponents off a raised platform. Flexible bodies and physical collisions turn a direct shove into a struggle for position. Your task is to remain on the arena after the other fighters have fallen, so moving safely matters as much as making contact. Short levels keep the focus on each encounter, and a leaderboard records results for players who want another target to pursue.
instructions: On desktop, hold the left mouse button and move the mouse to control your character. On mobile, use the virtual joystick with your finger. Move toward an opponent to engage them and try to send them over the boundary without following them off it. Keep checking the nearest edge whenever a collision changes your position. Watch the surrounding fighters before committing to a push, then reposition and continue until you are the last one standing.

title: Crumple Rumble
description: Crumple Rumble stages stickman fights on notebook paper, with doodled fighters, improvised weapons and finishing animations that fold or flatten a defeated rival. Choose from five characters and work through an arcade ladder, try the daily challenge, or keep fighting in survival mode. A local two-player option lets two people share the match. Pencils, staffs and pipes add variety to the exchanges, while a power bar builds toward a special move.
instructions: For the standard desktop layout, move with A/D or the arrow keys, jump with W, Up or Space, and jump again in the air for a double jump. J or Z punches, K or X kicks, and L or S blocks. Press Shift to dash and I when the power bar is full to use the special. Touch controls provide movement and attack buttons. Learn the separate layouts before local play, and use blocks between your combinations.

title: Attack & Dash
description: Attack & Dash follows a stickman ninja through compact arenas of enemies and obstacles. Each dash combines movement with a sword attack, so choosing a direction determines both what you hit and where you finish. Clear the opponents and reach the end of the arena while avoiding the hazards placed along the route. The short stages make it easy to focus on one sequence of moves at a time, with positioning becoming more demanding as the layouts develop.
instructions: On desktop, hold the left mouse button, point in the direction you want to travel, and release to dash. On a touchscreen, swipe in the desired direction. Look along the entire route before releasing your move: you need a useful attack path and a safe destination. Aim to connect your dashes through the remaining enemies without steering into an obstacle. If a direction leaves the ninja exposed, reassess the next line before making another attack.

title: Frogtress
description: Frogtress turns a frog's pond into a survival arena filled with incoming bugs. Automatic attacks keep the frog fighting, while your taps and croaks add direct control during each wave. Between waves, choose mutations that change the build; particular groups of four unlock fusions. The campaign moves through different ponds and boss encounters, with a rebirth skill tree offering another layer of progression. Clearing the boss at wave 30 purifies a pond before the run pushes deeper.
instructions: Click or tap a bug for an immediate lick. When the frog's belly fills, use the CROAK button or press Space to release the blast. After a wave, choose one of three mutations with the mouse or keys 1–3. Read how each option fits the upgrades already selected, especially when working toward a fusion. Keep an eye on the belly meter so the croak is ready when needed, and press P if you need to pause.

title: Food: Run and Battle
description: Food Run and Battle combines a lane-based collecting run with a confrontation at the finish. Guide your group along the course, gather food to increase its strength, and avoid the traps that threaten your progress. The reserve you bring to the final clash matters, giving the collection phase a clear purpose beyond reaching the end. Each course asks you to balance the food available along the route against the obstacles between your team and the finish line.
instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys on a computer, or hold the left mouse button and move the pointer. On mobile, swipe left and right to change position. Steer toward food while watching the next trap before committing to a lane. Aim to arrive at the final battle with as much collected food as you can preserve. Treat the run and the closing fight as connected stages: the route you choose prepares your team for the enemies ahead.

title: Tumble Tower Survival
description: Tumble Tower Survival asks you to stay on a giant stack of wooden blocks while disasters shift and topple the structure. The tower keeps changing beneath the characters, so a route that looked safe can suddenly become unstable. Falling into the water eliminates a contestant; the goal is to be the last one still on the tower. Power-ups offer help during the chaos, while earned points lead to levels, hats and color options for your character.
instructions: Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and Space to jump or climb. Click into the game to control the camera with the mouse, then use the wheel to adjust the zoom. On mobile, drag the left side to move, drag the right side to look, pinch to zoom and use the jump button. Watch for moving blocks and open gaps before jumping. P or Escape opens the pause controls on desktop.

title: AOD - Art Of Defense
description: AOD - Art Of Defense puts you in charge of a defensive squad in a post-apocalyptic campaign. Build a network of towers to stop an enemy force pursuing the lost Project Inola, with battles moving from small settlements to larger cities. Tanks, miniguns and anti-aircraft weapons sit alongside heroes and heavy support attacks. Tower cards and upgrades shape your defenses, while escape, fog and survival modes change the conditions under which you must protect the base.
instructions: Use the left mouse button to place a tower. Adjust the view with the scroll wheel or a pinch gesture when using a touchpad. Build your defenses around the approaching threat, upgrade the towers you rely on and bring heroes into the fight. Powerful attacks such as ballistic barrages and satellite strikes provide further options against difficult enemies. As the campaign introduces stronger forces and bosses, review both your tower upgrades and the abilities available to support them.

title: Merge Elementals: Castle Defense
description: Merge Elementals: Castle Defense alternates between arranging a magical army and holding off a horde. Matching fighters combine into stronger tiers, with twelve elements offering different attacks, slows and area effects. Each world contains ten waves ending in a boss, and your army and gold continue into the next biome. A limited grid makes every purchase and merge matter. Between encounters, upgrade your magic and choose three spells to take into battle.
instructions: Drag two elementals of the same type and tier together to merge them. Gold buys first-tier fighters; higher tiers come from combining them. Rearrange the lineup before pressing Start Wave, because merging is locked during combat. The fighters attack automatically, leaving you to time your spells and protect the wall. Defeated enemies drop gold for the next preparation phase. Use the break between waves to review the space available, improve the army and prepare for the world's boss.

title: Kingdom Defender - Tower Defense
description: Kingdom Defender - Tower Defense places your towers between a kingdom and invading fantasy creatures. Orcs, trolls, goblins and undead bring different threats to battles set in forests, mountains and deserts. Special tower upgrades and abilities give you ways to adapt, including fire, freezing effects and reinforcements. Boss encounters and additional difficulty settings extend the defensive challenge. The built-in encyclopedia explains towers and abilities, providing a useful reference when you want to understand an unfamiliar option.
instructions: Place towers to stop the incoming enemies and use special abilities while the battle is underway. Your objective is to prevent the attackers from breaking through to the kingdom. Review the available upgrades as the enemy mix changes, and consult the encyclopedia when deciding how a tower or power fits the situation. Keep an eye on the advancing groups before activating a limited opportunity to freeze, burn or reinforce. Boss waves require you to bring those defensive choices together.

title: Fleet Merge
description: Fleet Merge is a space auto-battler in which your dock also serves as the battle formation. Buy squadrons, combine matching ships and arrange the fleet before it deploys. Line ships, Artillery and Lancers form a counter system, so a stronger formation needs the right matchups as well as higher tiers. The Star Map includes sectors, bosses and giant Arks, while heroes and additional modes introduce defensive battles, convoy raids and challenges against other commanders' fleets.
instructions: Tap a ship type to buy it, then drag together two ships of the same type and tier to merge them. Arrange the dock with the front line at the top. Line ships beat Lancers, Lancers beat Artillery, and Artillery beats Line ships. Keep Artillery toward the rear and seek side or rear positions for Lancers. Read the enemy radar before pressing FIGHT; combat then runs automatically. Use credits and cores to upgrade the fleet between encounters.

title: Epic Battle Simulator 2
description: Epic Battle Simulator 2 focuses on choosing an army and arranging it before the fighting begins. Work through campaign levels or use custom mode to set up your own battle scenarios. Troop placement and the mix of units form the main strategic decisions, while the resulting encounters use physical collisions and ragdoll effects. Army upgrades provide three levels of development with improved equipment and statistics, giving you another way to change the outcome of a difficult matchup.
instructions: Choose your troops and place them on the battlefield with the opposing army in mind. Move the camera with WASD or the arrow keys on desktop; on mobile, touch the lower-left part of the screen and drag. Use the view to inspect the layout before committing to a formation. After a battle, reconsider the units or positions that failed to hold up, then try a revised setup. Custom battles offer room to compare different arrangements outside the campaign sequence.

title: Hex Hamlet
description: Hex Hamlet is a village-building strategy game set on wooded hexagonal islands. Turn a settlers' camp into a larger settlement by gathering resources, hiring villagers and placing buildings beside compatible neighbors. Merchant orders, hidden relics and a ship-building goal give each island more to do than simply clearing trees. Different islands introduce conditions such as winter, storms or volcanic activity. Complete the island's three objectives for stars, with Expert variants and a shared Island of the Week offering further challenges.
instructions: Move the pointer over the forest edge to chop trees without clicking, or tap a tree on mobile. Hire workers at the town hall and spend wood, food, stone and gold through the building cards. Check neighboring buildings for placement bonuses and click a structure to upgrade it. Drag to move the camera, right-drag or press Q/E to turn, and zoom with the wheel or two fingers. Clear the trees, finish the beach ship and sail onward.

title: Musketeers Gunpowder vs Steel
description: Musketeers Gunpowder vs Steel puts you in command of a group of soldiers in a seventeenth-century setting. The battles revolve around issuing movement and targeting orders while controlling the commander directly. You can turn the squad, advance it, halt it or bring it back toward you, so the action gives you more to manage than your own position. A pistol, a horse and a changeable camera view add further tools for directing the fight.
instructions: Control the commander's movement with the left mouse button or the joystick. On the keyboard, Q and E turn the squad, W advances it and X moves it backward. Press A to make the troops follow, S to stop them and D to indicate a target. F fires the pistol, V mounts the horse and Space changes the camera view. Practice the movement and stop commands first, then combine them with targeting orders so the unit stays where you intend during an engagement.

title: Line Control
description: Line Control turns a map of bases into a contest over routes and reinforcements. Draw connections to send squads into neutral or enemy positions, then use the points you capture to extend your control. Each level changes the balance between quick expansion and protecting the bases you already hold. Numbers displayed at the positions show their fighting strength, making the map a readable tactical problem where the timing and direction of one route can shift the outcome.
instructions: Draw a line from one of your bases to another point to dispatch a squad. Your goal is to take every enemy position while keeping your own network secure. Read the numbers before attacking, and capture available neutral points when they offer a useful foothold. Avoid committing all your squads at once if it leaves an important base exposed. Strengthen key positions, then choose the next route according to the remaining opposition and the places that need defending.

title: Epic Empire: Tower Defense
description: Epic Empire: Tower Defense combines defensive towers with three heroes you can control during the battle. Goblins, ogres and larger bosses advance through locations ranging from icy kingdoms to underground tunnels. Runes and pets support your defenders, while hero development unlocks additional abilities. The game includes campaign levels, challenge content and tournaments; replaying stages at a higher difficulty offers stronger rewards. Gold is used within battles, while rubies contribute to longer-term character upgrades.
instructions: Use the left mouse button or tap the screen to interact with the interface. Place towers to hold the route and direct your heroes against the incoming waves, keeping the kingdom protected through the boss encounters. Review how the current heroes, towers, runes and pets work together before increasing the difficulty. If a stage becomes difficult, replay earlier levels to develop the heroes and unlock more abilities. Plan your gold spending for the active battle and your ruby spending for character development.

title: Animals Battle
description: Animals Battle puts an army of animal warriors at the center of an island-conquering strategy game. New territories introduce different biomes and increasingly strong opposition, while recruited fighters and upgrades expand the army available to you. Battles depend on an automatically generated food supply that pays for units. Between encounters, coins improve your base and unlock additional creatures, and collected artifact cards provide lasting bonuses across future fights. The campaign links those economic decisions to the next island's defenses.
instructions: Use the food produced during combat to summon animal units, then send the growing army against the opposing base. Destroying that base completes the level. Watch the available food before adding more troops so your deployment matches the resources being generated. After a victory, spend earned coins on new units or improved base statistics. Review the artifact cards you collect, since their bonuses continue to apply in later battles. Strengthen the army as each conquered island leads to tougher enemies.

title: TRAFFIC Rush Online
description: TRAFFIC Rush Online combines city driving with a choice of online play, unrestricted Free Ride and a traffic-dodging mode. Invite friends or meet other drivers online, then switch to the other modes when you want to explore or chase a distance record. Driving farther earns money for vehicle improvements and new cars. As you develop the garage, colors, wheels and exterior parts provide customization choices alongside the practical challenge of getting through busy roads without a collision.
instructions: Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive on desktop, C to change the camera and Space for the handbrake. Mobile players can use on-screen buttons or a steering wheel, with the control style selected in settings. In Traffic mode, look for a clear lane and control your speed before passing another car. Avoid crashes while extending the distance of your run. Spend earned money on upgrades or another vehicle, and choose online mode when you want to drive with others.

title: Ragdoll Soccer
description: Ragdoll Soccer puts a flexible stickman footballer between the ball and the goal. Play alone or challenge a friend in local two-player matches, with the character's loose movements making each attempt to strike the ball part of the challenge. Championship and penalty-shootout modes offer different ways to compete, while boosters and abilities add options during play. The central aim is familiar football scoring, but moving the player like a doll gives the sport a different rhythm.
instructions: Control the stickman and make contact with the ball to send it into the opponent's goal. On a computer, the game supports a keyboard layout using WASD and Q/E, as well as mouse or gamepad input. On a phone, use touch controls. Start with a solo match to learn how the player responds before sharing a local game with a friend. Track the ball's position, recover after a mistimed movement and use the available abilities when they suit the situation.

title: 2 Player Games Mini Games
description: 2 Player Games Mini Games collects small competitive activities for two people sharing a single device. The menu includes tennis, air hockey, curling, billiards and tic-tac-toe, so switching games also changes the skill being tested. Matches use short rounds and score-based rules, while an AI opponent provides a solo option when another player is unavailable. This is local multiplayer on one screen, making the shared controls and each activity's rules the important things to check before a match.
instructions: Choose a mini-game from the menu and read the controls shown for both players. Press start, then follow that mode's objective: return the ball, guide the puck or place your marks as appropriate. Aim for the highest score in the round. Use the solo opponent to learn an unfamiliar activity before playing together. When changing games, check the new control instructions again, since the same collection covers several different styles of competition.

title: Toy Soccer Cup
description: Toy Soccer Cup plays football with flickable miniature figures on a tabletop pitch. Aim a player toward the ball, release the flick and try to send the shot into the goal before the timer expires. Tournaments and world leagues give you a progression route, while real-time online duels put two players into a direct match. Wins earn coins for new teams and equipment, with kits, balls and pitches available to change the look of the game.
instructions: Click and drag one of your toy players on desktop, or touch and drag on mobile. Aim the movement, then release to flick the figure into the ball; no keyboard input is needed. Score more goals than your rival before time runs out. Think about where the ball will go after contact, then adjust the next flick to the new position. Use match rewards to unlock teams and gear, and enter online 1v1 play when you want a direct opponent.

title: BOMB PONG: ONLINE
description: BOMB PONG: ONLINE is a timing duel in which the object passed between opponents is a bomb. Return it at the right moment and keep up as the exchanges become more intense. You can practice against bots, face a friend on the same device, create a private online room or enter ranked multiplayer. Those options make it possible to learn the timing alone and then use the same central action in local or online competition, with ranked results contributing to a global leaderboard.
instructions: On desktop, press A or click the left mouse button to hit the bomb. In local two-player mode, the first player uses A and the second uses L. On mobile, tap the screen while holding the device in landscape orientation. Watch the bomb approach and time the return instead of pressing continuously. Use bot matches to get comfortable with the rhythm, then choose the room or multiplayer mode that matches how you want to play.

title: Bomb Royale Online
description: Bomb Royale Online sends bear characters into maze-like arenas for explosive player-versus-player survival. Bombs destroy obstacles and threaten nearby opponents, while traps and chain reactions can quickly change which routes are safe. The aim is to outlast the other contestants and become the final survivor. Opening a passage can create an opportunity to attack, but it also changes the space available to everyone else, making the arena layout part of each decision.
instructions: Move through the maze and place bombs to break blocks or threaten an opponent's position. Plan an escape route before committing to an explosion, and watch for other bombs that could trigger a chain reaction along it. Use newly cleared paths to reposition, or try to limit an enemy's exits with careful placement. Do not remain beside your own blast area while watching the result. Keep surviving as opponents are eliminated, then use the changing layout to reach the end of the match.

title: SnakeWar.io
description: SnakeWar.io is an online snake arena where collecting fruit increases your length and your score. Other players create both danger and opportunity: a rival that hits your body is eliminated and leaves a large fruit drop behind. Speed boosts help with escapes or attempts to cut off another snake, but they consume length. The match therefore balances steady growth with the risk of close encounters, while a leaderboard tracks the largest competitors and skins change your snake's appearance.
instructions: Move the mouse to guide the snake and hold the left mouse button to boost. Eat fruit along your route and collect the drops left by defeated rivals when it is safe to approach. Try to make an opponent's head touch your body while protecting your own path. Use acceleration briefly, since sustained boosting makes your snake smaller. Give larger snakes room until you have space to maneuver, and avoid chasing a tempting fruit pile into a trap.

title: Red & Blue: Online. Build! Destroy! Fight!
description: Red & Blue: Online. Build! Destroy! Fight! combines team shooting with a destructible block world. Buildings can collapse when their blocks lose support, letting construction and demolition reshape the battle. Capture the Flag focuses on bringing the enemy flag back to base, Team Deathmatch rewards eliminations, and Sandbox opens up building experiments. Online matchmaking and custom rooms provide ways to enter a session, with fortifications and newly cut passages giving teams more to consider than direct fire.
instructions: Use WASD to move, Space to jump and C to crouch. The left mouse button shoots or builds, while the right button aims or digs depending on the selected item. Choose items with 1–5 and reload with R. Press M for the map, J to change the minimap size or Tab for the pause menu. Learn the current mode's objective before fighting, and watch structural supports when digging: removing them can bring disconnected blocks down around the battlefield.

title: RoboStrike 3D
description: RoboStrike 3D scales everyday places into combat arenas for small robots. Fight through a kitchen, attic, greenhouse or scrapyard in online matches, or practice against bots. Deathmatch asks for the most eliminations, while Batteries and Mega Robot add team objectives: power a cannon to destroy an opposing tower, or charge a giant robot to attack the enemy core. Weapon choices, movement options and garage customization give you ways to prepare your robot for those different roles.
instructions: Move with WASD and look with the mouse. Left-click to shoot, right-click to aim, press Space to jump and Shift to sprint. Press C during a sprint to slide, R to reload and 1–3 to switch weapons. E interacts with objects. In Batteries, collect and deliver batteries to your team's base; in Mega Robot, help charge the team's robot. Follow the selected mode's objective, since eliminations alone do not complete every type of match.

title: Ragdoll Football Online
description: Ragdoll Football Online makes each footballer's movement a deliberate push followed by a loose tumble. Practice alone, play one-versus-one or two-versus-two games against bots, or search for an online opponent. The aim remains to score more goals than the other team, but positioning a floppy player requires attention to the strength and direction of every movement. Replays let you revisit the resulting plays, and collectible cards provide changes to the player's kit as you continue.
instructions: Select the mode you want, then press on the pitch and drag toward the direction of movement. Release to push the player; a longer drag creates a stronger push. With a keyboard, hold a WASD or arrow key in the desired direction and release it to move. Start with shorter pushes to understand the response before committing to a larger movement. Follow the ball after each tumble, adjust your next direction and create another chance to score.

title: Hidden Object: Clues and Mysteries
description: Hidden Object: Clues and Mysteries follows an experienced detective through rooms filled with small details and concealed items. Living rooms, cafés, kitchens, and private studies give each search a different setting. The detective's spoken guidance and gentle music support a relaxed investigation, while the object hunts reward careful observation. This is an adventure for players who enjoy examining a scene closely and gradually making sense of what they find.
instructions: Search each location for its hidden objects, moving the view left and right to inspect the full scene. Zoom in when an item's shape blends into the furnishings or background. A useful approach is to scan one section at a time, then revisit the edges before moving on. Follow the detective's guidance as you work through the mysteries. Both desktop and mobile versions support exploring the locations, so use the view controls to bring smaller details into focus.

title: Hidden Object: Street Of Secrets
description: Hidden Object: Street Of Secrets casts you as a lead detective with an assistant to help identify important details. Your investigation moves between evening streets, cafés, and mysterious rooms, with a fresh collection of concealed objects in each scene. Finding the complete list advances the case. Coins and trophies also provide a reason to return, since they can be spent on outfits for the main character. The leisurely pace keeps attention on observation and the unfolding detective story.
instructions: Pan left and right to examine the entire location, then zoom in on crowded or dimly detailed areas. Find every object on the current list before progressing. Work through recognizable shapes first and use your assistant's hints when a remaining item is difficult to distinguish. Scanning in an orderly direction can help you avoid repeatedly checking the same objects. The game supports desktop and mobile play, with the same scene exploration and item-searching objective.

title: Hidden Object: My Hotel
description: Hidden Object: My Hotel turns a renovation story into a series of detailed searches. The heroine has bought an old hotel and needs help restoring its charm, starting with the clutter that fills its rooms. Your role is to identify carefully concealed objects among the furnishings and scattered belongings. Colorful interiors and a practical cleanup theme give the searches a clear purpose: help bring an overlooked building back into shape, one room at a time.
instructions: Explore each messy room and locate the hidden items needed for the cleanup. Move the scene left or right to see areas outside the initial view, and zoom in to separate small objects from the surrounding clutter. Start with a systematic sweep of the room, checking furniture surfaces and the spaces around them. If an item still escapes you, use a hint to narrow the search. The same exploration tools are available for desktop and mobile play.

title: Hidden Objects: Island
description: Hidden Objects: Island builds its adventure around a varied collection of illustrated destinations. Beaches, Japanese gardens, fishing villages, and even flying houses provide settings for concealed objects and small discoveries. Searching the scenes is part of a wider journey through puzzles, secrets, and rare treasures. The appeal comes from examining each location's details and noticing how ordinary objects can disappear into a busy picture. It suits players who prefer observation and exploration to fast reactions.
instructions: Click an object on desktop, or tap it on a supported mobile device, when you identify it in the picture. Look across the whole scene before concentrating on smaller details so that you have a sense of its layout. Check outlines and partially obscured shapes when a target is difficult to recognize. Hints can reveal items that are taking longer to find. Continue searching, solving the available puzzles, and collecting treasures as the island's locations open up.

title: Wild Love
description: Wild Love is an interactive story set on a mysterious island, where the heroine must decide whom to trust as danger surrounds her. You can choose her appearance before following the adventure and shaping her responses at key moments. The central activity is reading, considering the people she meets, and selecting what she says or does. Its island mystery gives those conversations a clear purpose: work out who may be a friend, who may be an enemy, and what lies behind the danger.
instructions: Advance through the novel and read the dialogue and scene descriptions before making a choice. When decision buttons appear, select the response or action you want the heroine to take. Pay attention to what characters have already said, since that context can help you judge the next conversation. Use the appearance options to give the heroine a look you prefer, then continue the story and its investigation through the choices presented on screen.

title: My Castle. Merge & Story
description: My Castle. Merge & Story follows a young princess who leaves her father's court for an abandoned castle once owned by her grandfather. Restoring and decorating that building forms the backdrop to a story about beginning again and uncovering the reasons for her departure. Its puzzles use a merge-two system: identical objects become improved tools or resources. Medieval items, hidden upgrade chains, and new crafting possibilities connect the board's small discoveries with the castle's gradual renewal.
instructions: Combine two matching items to produce the next object in their chain. Use the resulting tools and resources as you progress with restoration and decoration. Before merging, look over the available items so you can recognize pairs and follow a promising chain deliberately. Discovering rarer objects expands your crafting options as the castle develops. The game does not place a timer on these merge tasks, so take time to understand how each new item fits into your progress.

title: Blackriver Mystery. Hidden Objects
description: Blackriver Mystery. Hidden Objects gives a mystical detective a town to rebuild and a mystery to investigate. Hidden-object scenes are connected by quests, collections, and a story involving monsters and strange anomalies. The search is only part of the work: match-three puzzles and other mini-games add different tasks as you help restore the ruined town. Its combination of investigation and reconstruction provides a longer sense of purpose beyond finding the final item in a single picture.
instructions: Use the left mouse button on desktop or touch controls on a supported mobile device to interact with the game. Follow the current quest, search the indicated locations, and collect the objects needed to continue. When a mini-game appears, switch attention to its objective; match-three sections also offer boosters. Read the task before spending effort on a scene, and examine crowded areas methodically. Progress comes from completing the connected quests and puzzles while following the town's story.

title: The Escape Series
description: The Escape Series is a room-escape adventure built around observation, codes, and the useful objects hidden in an environment. Each space presents its own puzzles and riddles, so progress depends on understanding what the room is telling you. A small detail can be a clue, while an apparently ordinary object may help with another obstacle. The objective is clear throughout: investigate the surroundings, connect the information you discover, and find a way out.
instructions: Use the mouse to select objects and interact with the room. Inspect the visible details, gather useful clues, and apply what you learn to the codes and puzzles blocking your escape. A practical approach is to examine the whole room before trying a difficult mechanism, then revisit it with the new information. Compare symbols, arrangements, or other clues that the game actually shows you. Solve each space's distinct challenges to uncover its exit and continue the escape.

title: Detective Max Mystery: The Disappearance of Mr. Winters
description: Detective Max Mystery: The Disappearance of Mr. Winters begins with an unusual postcard from Max's neighbor, Benedict Winters. He says he left in a hurry, will not return, and wants a small missing box found. That request leads into an apartment investigation combining detective work with escape-room puzzles. You search for evidence, inspect the surroundings, and use collected objects to understand the disappearance. The personal message gives the case a specific question to follow rather than a room to search without context.
instructions: Point and click on areas you want to investigate. Examine the apartment for evidence and the mysterious box, then use items stored in your inventory where they may be relevant. Some puzzles require clicking and dragging objects instead of simply selecting them. Revisit an unresolved detail after finding a new item or clue, since the additional context may make its purpose clearer. If the investigation stalls, use the available hint to help identify a next step.

title: Desolate Isle: Survival
description: Desolate Isle: Survival puts you on a mysterious island with the longer-term aim of surviving and finding an escape. Gathering materials, crafting tools, and building a base create the foundation for exploration. Quests unlock new territories, and those areas introduce additional resources and challenges. The adventure therefore develops through practical preparation as much as discovery: improve what you can make, establish your foothold, and use that progress to investigate more of the island.
instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys on desktop. On mobile, use the joystick to move and turn. Most interactions happen automatically when you approach an object closely enough, although some objects display a button that you must press. Gather available materials and follow quests to guide your next construction or exploration goal. Check the current requirements before setting out for resources, and watch for interaction prompts so that a required button press does not leave a task unfinished.

title: Primal Druid - Kingdom of Animals
description: Primal Druid - Kingdom of Animals makes creature recruitment the center of its wilderness adventure. You battle wild animals and beasts to turn them into allies, then develop a squad that can face stronger threats. Resource gathering and artifact crafting support that growth, while quests provide rewards and reasons to explore. The open world includes varied creatures and dangers, so building your army involves both finding new companions and improving the abilities of those already following you.
instructions: Use WASD to move on desktop, or tap and drag on the screen on mobile. Explore the wilderness, engage creatures to tame them, and follow quests for further objectives. Collect materials for artifacts and upgrades that strengthen your squad. A useful approach is to develop the allies you have while preparing for the next challenge, rather than focusing only on recruitment. Pay attention to available resources during exploration, since collecting and crafting are part of the army's progression.

title: Pocket ZONE
description: Pocket ZONE is a survival role-playing adventure centered on an anomalous and hostile landscape. Exploring, gathering resources, and choosing equipment are joined by random text events whose outcomes depend on your decisions and external circumstances. Weapons, armor, helmets, and backpacks offer different ways to prepare for the journey. The game's tension comes from making choices with survival in mind, then adapting to what the next encounter reveals about the Zone and the conditions around you.
instructions: Click game elements with the left mouse button on desktop and use the mouse wheel to scroll through lists. On mobile, tap the interface to interact. Read event descriptions before selecting a response, and review the equipment and resources available to you as the journey develops. The choices are contextual, so a previous result does not guarantee that a later event will unfold identically. Keep preparation and exploration connected: examine your options before committing to the next situation.

title: MiniMight: Fantasy RPG
description: MiniMight: Fantasy RPG follows a small party of adventurers through floors occupied by monsters and powerful bosses. Warriors, archers, mages, and other fighters give you options when assembling the group. Battles supply gold and equipment, which feed back into stronger heroes, new skills, and further recruitment. Defeating a boss opens access to another floor, creating a clear cycle of party preparation, combat, and improvement as the expedition pushes deeper.
instructions: Choose your party members before entering the adventure. During a fight, select a character and use that hero's attacks or skills against the enemies. Collect the gold and items earned afterward, then review equipment upgrades, new skills, and stronger recruits before continuing. Consider how each party member contributes when deciding where to spend rewards. A difficult boss is a useful point to reassess the team's abilities and gear, since overcoming it unlocks the next stage of the journey.

title: Runic Curse
description: Runic Curse follows Adrian after a shipwreck leaves him on a mysterious island. His search for the missing crew leads through ruins, enemies, and the secrets of the Rune Curse. Combat combines melee weapons, magic runes, and an endurance system, while character growth offers equipment, improved attributes, and abilities that open previously inaccessible areas. Crafting and upgrading runes adds another way to shape your approach as exploration and battles become more demanding.
instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with Space, and fight or select with the left mouse button. Shift performs a roll, while 1, 2, and 3 activate abilities. Open the menu with Tab and the map with M. Watch endurance during combat and use the roll's brief protection deliberately. Compare weapons and rune combinations as you progress, and revisit blocked routes when a newly acquired ability may let you reach them.

title: Heroes of the Dungeons: Match-3 RPG
description: Heroes of the Dungeons: Match-3 RPG places puzzle battles inside a campaign to rebuild a fallen kingdom. A mysterious gate has released monsters across the realm, and your role as Master of Hunters is to assemble heroes and fight back. Matching tiles powers attacks and skills, while successful battles provide treasures and materials. Castle shops turn those rewards into income and stronger heroes, linking progress on the puzzle board with the kingdom's recovery.
instructions: Swap adjacent tiles to make matches of three or more. Matches attack enemies and charge your team's skills, while combinations can create special blocks. Check the board for follow-up matches before settling on an obvious move, and use ready hero abilities with enemy weaknesses in mind. After a victory, collect the loot and spend suitable rewards on castle-shop upgrades. Return to later stages with the improvements those upgrades provide, balancing immediate battle decisions with the team's ongoing development.

title: Arcuz Treasure Hunters
description: Arcuz Treasure Hunters is a fantasy role-playing adventure about exploring underground caves and assembling a capable treasure-hunting team. Companions bring different abilities, while the dungeons combine powerful enemies with traps, puzzles, and hidden passages. Story locations contain fixed scenes and treasures, and randomly generated dungeons add variety to later exploration. Progress depends on examining the environment as well as strengthening the party, since simply moving forward can leave useful routes and discoveries unexplored.
instructions: Follow the game's interface to explore each area and manage your companions. Inspect the surroundings for puzzle elements, traps, and possible hidden passages, then coordinate the team's abilities as you investigate. When a route is unclear, examine the nearby scene components before assuming that every obstacle requires a fight. Hire companions with varied capabilities and keep the party's options in mind during exploration. Search both the story dungeons and the generated areas for treasures that reward a more thorough visit.

title: Knight Legend
description: Knight Legend sends a developing hero through monster-filled stages, with better gear and new areas marking your progress. Defeating enemies earns money that can be spent on armor and pets, giving the adventure two linked forms of improvement: stronger protection for the knight and companions that help in battle. Its structure is straightforward, with fighting, collecting gold, and reviewing upgrades preparing you for the next set of encounters and newly unlocked levels.
instructions: Move with the arrow keys, WASD, or ZQSD on desktop. Enter confirms a selection, while Escape pauses the game or closes a menu. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick to move and tap the confirmation button when needed. Work through the available encounters, collect gold, and check the armor and pet options as you advance. Consider both the knight's equipment and companion support when preparing for a harder level, rather than overlooking the purchases available between stretches of combat.

title: Duohex
description: Duohex is a spellbook auto-battler where preparation determines what your mage brings to an automatic duel. You purchase and combine spells, then arrange them across a two-page grimoire. Neighboring spells on the same page link together, making placement part of the strategy. Solo play pits you against AI mages, while Duo adds an AI teammate in eight-entry tournaments. The goal is to collect ten trophies before your remaining lives run out.
instructions: Drag spells from the shop onto the spellbook using a mouse or touch. Buy another copy to merge a spell, reroll the shop for one gold, lock useful offers, or sell spells you no longer want. Check adjacency on each individual page before starting the next automatic fight. Review the result to decide whether a different arrangement or purchase could improve the build. In Duo, your partner shops and battles alongside you under AI control.

title: Wander Wild
description: Wander Wild combines turn-based card battles with a camp that develops across a fantasy adventure. Attack, defense, and ability cards provide tactical choices, while status effects and charged super attacks add ways to shape a fight. Victories bring rewards for relics and camp improvements, linking individual encounters to longer-term character growth. Each chapter contains fifteen battles, so choosing useful combinations matters both for the next enemy and for the challenges still ahead.
instructions: Choose cards each turn to attack, protect yourself, or apply effects such as poison, bleeding, burning, stun, and weakening. Build energy for a super attack and use it when its impact fits the situation. Equip up to four relics, considering how their effects complement your cards or improve the super attack. Between battles, spend earned resources on camp upgrades that strengthen your hero. Reassess your combination after new rewards instead of treating every encounter as the same tactical problem.

title: Battlecross
description: Battlecross lets a hero combine abilities learned from different teachers rather than follow a single class throughout the adventure. Equipment, attributes, active skills, and passive skills shape how you face groups of enemies and their leaders. Towns provide shops, healing services, and trainers, but story decisions can change who remains available and how the world develops. Some choices are irreversible, giving the campaign's conversations consequences alongside its combat and character building.
instructions: Approach an enemy to attack automatically, then use skills and health potions as needed. Clear every enemy group and the area's leader to complete a zone; experience and loot remain even after defeat. Each level grants three attribute points. In towns, buy gear, expand your potion belt, and learn abilities for eight active and four passive slots from sixteen classes. Read major end-of-zone decisions carefully, since they can alter towns, shops, trainers, and the ending.

title: Mushroom Runners
description: Mushroom Runners combines an endless run with jumping, stomping, and size-changing mushrooms. Your route is filled with obstacles and enemies, while collected mushrooms can make the character grow enormous. A flying cloud adds another feature to the journey. The main challenge is reading what lies ahead and choosing an appropriate response before the scenery catches up with you. Its platforming actions give the run more variety than simply moving around each obstacle.
instructions: On desktop, press the Up arrow to jump and the Down arrow to stomp the ground. On mobile, touch the screen to jump and swipe downward to stomp. Watch the next stretch of the route so you can distinguish a jump from a useful stomp. Collect mushrooms while managing nearby hazards, and pay attention when the character's size changes.
